column1: # Verified against live ENA and the 1000 Genomes pedigree file (20130606_g1k.ped)
# on 2026-08-13. Read length was MEASURED from the first reads of each file, not
# derived from ENA's base_count/read_count — that estimate was wrong for 4 of the
# 8 runs (it reported 299 bp for 150 bp data, because those runs count spots
# sex, population and the pedigree columns are REAL, from the 1000 Genomes panel.
# phenotype is SYNTHETIC — invented for this course. See is_synthetic_phenotype.
# The synthetic labels are assigned so they correlate with nothing technical:
# affected = 2M/2F, unaffected = 2M/2F, all three studies appear in both groups,
# and the two single-end samples are one per group. Any difference a student finds
# between the groups therefore cannot be an artefact of how the data was made.
